user.title: Add a location
user.description: Pick the point you want a rain nowcast for. Coverage is best within about 150 km of an Estonian radar.

error.out_of_range: This location is beyond the range of the Estonian radar network (nearest radar: {radar}, {distance} km). No usable data is available here.
error.no_radar_data: The radar network has no data at this location. It is inside the composite's area but no radar covers it (nearest radar: {radar}, {distance} km), so every sensor would read unknown.

data_description.rain_threshold: Rain rate at or above which the location counts as wet.
data_description.window_radius: How many radar pixels around the location are averaged. Larger values are smoother but less local.
data_description.forecast_minutes: How far ahead to extrapolate. Accuracy drops sharply past an hour.

get_forecast.name: Get forecast
get_forecast.description: Returns the point precipitation nowcast as a list of timestamped rain rates.

no_forecast.message: No radar forecast is available yet for this location.
